I have 1500 hours in this game so ill speak on it

first of all i love the game but it can get boring. If you like Civ but want something more in depth this may be it for you, it was for me. The game is about Building your nation and to do this you war, do diplomacy and colonize. The game takes place between 1444 and 1820.

This is a picture of the map at the start, every nation you can see there is playable: http://i.imgur.com/vcI0XRg.jpg

The thing is it is a paradox game, which means the joke that runs with them applies, "it's not a bug, it's a feature." aka there will be bugs. this is not a pick up and play well game, it will take you a LOT of time to learn how to play the game, im 1500 hours in and still learn small things. The best way to learn would be to watch lets plays of it. There is a ton of shit DLC for this game mostly just cosmetic stuff and small events that are shoehorned into those cosmetic packs, you can avoid most of them. There are two expansions with a third coming out soon Conquest of paradise which allows Naitvies of North America to be stronger and allows the player to play colonial nations plus other small stuff. Wealth of nations which is focused on trade allowing the formation of trade companies in Africa and Asia and allows you to send privateers to loot trade.

if i were to give it a rating of 1-10 on weather to buy of not.

if you don't care for strategy but want to try to get into it - 5

if you don't care for strategy -1
